scene.speaker: maya
scene.bubble: Kili has to deliver a letter to the new museum — let's give him directions from the sky!

activities.title: Match the direction with its meaning.

pairs.right: walk in front of it and continue
it's on the other side of the street

data.instructions: Choose the correct word for each gap.

items.sentence: Walk ___ the river until you see the bridge.
Go ___ the bridge and turn right.
Go ___ the supermarket — don't stop there.
The chemist's is ___ the bank, on the other side.
Turn left at the ___ of the street.

activities.title: Listen. Maya guides Kili to the museum. Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Maya (guiando) y Kili (graznidos de confirmación — narrar sus acciones).
data.script: Maya: Okay Kili, fly straight on along the main street. … Maya: Now turn left at the clock tower. … Maya: Do you see the market? Go past it — don't stop for food! … Maya: Now fly over the old stone bridge. … Maya: Go through the city park, between the tall trees. … Maya: The museum is opposite the fountain — the building with the red roof. … Maya: Perfect landing! Give the letter to the manager. Mission complete!

data.text: Student A closes their eyes. Student B guides them through the classroom with directions (slowly and safely!): "Three steps straight on… turn left…" Goal: reach the door. Then swap.

activities.title: A and B are not the same. Find out why!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Write directions from your home to school in 4-5 steps using: straight on, turn, past, opposite.

outcomes.puede: Understand dialogues and short stories (Flyers parts 1–5); infer mood from intonation.
Narrate stories with past/present/future; express preferences with reasons.
Read and understand short stories (80–250 words); find main idea and detail.
Writing Part 3: 20–25-word picture story (Flyers); classroom pieces 100–150w.
~2500 words (Flyers wordlist); Present perfect intro, tag Qs, 0th conditional, be going to.
